review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form; encourage a new, substantially shorter submission centered on amortized continuation learning and prospectively measured work-to-accuracy.

risk.scope: conditional contrast risk at frozen NBO/reference action pairs and realized Raw caches

catalogue.analysis: post-freeze deterministic exact closure of simultaneous intervals

work.early_stage_clocks: prefix allocations, not prospective stopping clocks

positive_findings: R18 supplies direct positive economic evidence for reusable continuation learning in specified finite menu cells.
The independent continuation-risk assessment uses a correct common-noise cancellation statistic and retains all outcomes.
The finite-catalogue shortest-path closure is mathematically correct under the stated simultaneous event.
The work account exposes rather than hides cheaper Raw and vector procedures and SAA reversals.
The publication, chronology and confidence-family disclosures are unusually strong.
blocking_findings: The strongest positive result is local to an engineered finite repeated-decision menu and does not establish broad NBO applicability.
The risk comparison is conditional on NBO-selected action pairs and realized Raw caches and does not identify own-decision or unconditional method value.
Least-cost-certified selection is retrospective, not a prospective measured work-to-tolerance stopping result.
The paper does not estimate the query-volume amortization frontier that defines the claimed computational advantage.
The contribution is insufficiently isolated against standard postdecision-value, approximate dynamic programming and surrogate baselines.
The economic menu and 1e-4 threshold are too stylized relative to Econometrica-level economic content.
Finite-menu evidence does not validate NBO as an accurate continuous-time high-dimensional HJB solver.
The cumulative 49-page article plus 235 pages of technical supplement and applications is disproportionate to the established core.

review_manifest.json.description: Pinned snapshot, evidence ledger, recommendation and review limitations; deliberately omits its own hash

limitations: The reviewer did not rerun the 640 menu fits, 12.6 million risk-audit pair observations, or all historical continuous-time experiments.
The assessment uses the immutable source, protocols, stored reports, mathematical arguments and committed aggregate evidence.
No claim is made that an unresolved comparison proves equality or that Raw, SAA or NBO universally dominates.
This advisory report is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
